title: Late Fee Charged on an Overdue Retrofit Project Account
content:
# Late Fee Charged on an Overdue Retrofit Project Account

Where billings on a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects have run past their due day, the project has run up a late fee and that fee is charged to the owner on the project's account.

## What the charge does

Raising the fee adds a late fee line to the project's record entries, dated the day it is raised and falling due that same day, and the amount owed on the project rises by the same amount. The owner sees the late fee on the project statement and a higher project balance.

## Raising the fee

The fee is raised by the agent with the tool `bill_overdue_late_fee_5c3179f3`, a hidden tool that is unlocked and then called by the agent. One call raises one late fee line on one project.

### Parameters

- `project_id` — the reference number of the replacement or retrofit project the late fee is raised on, as it stands in the project lookup for this owner.
- `late_fee_amount_usd` — the money amount of the late fee line, in USD, given as a decimal number rounded half to even to 2 decimal places; it is stored to that same precision and may not be left empty.

The tool carries no other parameters and no enumerated values.

### Return

A confirmation sentence in plain text carrying the reference of the late fee record entry created on the project, the amount charged in USD to two decimal places, the day the line was dated and the project balance after it. That sentence is what indicates the late fee was raised; the owner sees the same line and the same balance on the project statement.
